column1: # Managed surface of the live setup ("setup as code").
#   file        single file, repo content wins on apply
#   dir         managed directory; default apply adds/updates repo files and keeps
#               live extras (flagged as drift); `setup-apply.sh --prune` removes extras
#   json-state  JSON document whose records mix config and runtime fields;
#               drift compares config fields only, apply merges repo config with
#               live runtime fields (volatile=<set>); only `cron` set is defined
# flags: volatile=cron | systemctl-reload (unit changed -> daemon-reload hint)
# Excluded by design: secrets (.env, auth.json), runtime state (state.db, sessions,
# memories, logs, .artifacts, work/), generated files (SOUL.profile.md, skins),
# plugin install trees, skills (H curates them itself), non-hermes systemd units,
# .claude.json (session state), omh/ plugin dir (managed by hermes-omh-update).
